summary: Add inactive per-job Linux scope plans and configured heavy-ceiling checks (unit 12a)

rules.detail: No host activation; gate-slot remains the admission path.

compatibility.detail: Additive pure Rust plan and systemd property builder. Memory high/max, task count and heavy ceilings are required configuration, without policy defaults. Swap is zero. io.weight is not an IO limit and has no effect with NVMe scheduler none.
